User.title: User
User.description: User profile with role-based access control, account status, permissions, and pay-per-use tracking metrics

uid.description: Unique user ID matching Auth UID

role.description: Application role determining permissions and dashboard access

spendingLimitKes.description: Pay-per-use spending quota limit in KES

incurredCostKes.description: Total accrued usage cost in KES

totalStorageKb.description: Total estimated storage consumed in kilobytes

Admin.title: Admin
Admin.description: Administrator registry mapping granting full system governance rights

assignedAt.description: Timestamp when admin role was granted

Auditor.title: Auditor
Auditor.description: Auditor registry mapping granting compliance oversight and read-only financial review rights

assignedAt.description: Timestamp when auditor role was granted

AuditLog.title: AuditLog
AuditLog.description: System operational, security, and user activity log entry for admin and auditor review

userId.description: Identifier of the actor or subject

action.description: Action performed (e.g., USER_UPDATE, ROLE_ASSIGN, DATA_SYNC, BILLING_UPDATE)

readCostKes.description: Cost per Firestore read operation in KES

writeCostKes.description: Cost per Firestore write operation in KES

storageMbMonthKes.description: Cost per MB of storage per month in KES

apiCallCostKes.description: Cost per API/Sync request in KES

aiForecastCostKes.description: Cost per AI forecasting run in KES

AuditVerification.title: AuditVerification
AuditVerification.description: Auditor verification stamp and compliance assessment record for a client financial period

auditorEmail.description: Email address of the verifying auditor

notes.description: Auditor audit notes and statutory observations

dpaComplianceConfirmed.description: Whether Kenya DPA 2019 compliance check passed

ReviewChatMessage.title: ReviewChatMessage
ReviewChatMessage.description: Real-time chat message exchanged within a shared review session

shareId.description: ID of the parent shared review

/users/{userId}.description: Individual user accounts, profile details, roles, permissions, and usage metrics

/auditors/{auditorId}.description: Registry of authorized financial and compliance auditors

/auditLogs/{logId}.description: System operational, security, and pay-per-use audit logs
